751-4460-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

34-147-2921.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-2921.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3293-5282-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-5282-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3781-4215-8095--124.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
3781-4215-8095--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

2178-2292-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-2292-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-2292-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

877-3081-3817-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-6669-7694.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Multiversal Incursion twice, with the copies
Resolve all Multiversal Incursions, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-3112-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

757-3181-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

1477-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

891-1052-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1874-2308-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
1874-2308-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3053-4067-6281-7206.easyPrerequisites:
There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
You control three or more creatures.
3053-4067-6281-7206.description:
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat.

719-2292-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-2292-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

486-1526-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
486-1526-1978.description:
Cause Circle of Dreams Druid to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

5231-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5231-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2043-6671-6705.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Magic Pot that is a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot token and the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot token dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4508-5880-5929-6753.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

11-4503-5195-5487.description:
Cast Sea Gate Stormcaller by paying {1}{U}.
When Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}, targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Molten Duplication, with the copy targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Molten Duplication.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Molten Duplication.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Molten Duplication to your hand and creating a copy of Molten Duplication targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Molten Duplication copy, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1445-3967-4871-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3967-4871-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1022-6285.notablePrerequisites:
Lord Xander does not have summoning sickness.
You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
1022-6285.description:
Declare Lord Xander as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard.

997-1447-2719.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

575-880-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one green card in hand.
575-880-4674.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

648-4341.notablePrerequisites: Your library size is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
648-4341.description:
Cast Body of Reaserch by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to your deck size.
Cast Soul's Fire by paying {2}{R}, dealing damage equal to the Fractal's power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1283-1810-2397-2493-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures.
1283-1810-2397-2493-4739.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {2}, adding {1} for each creature you control.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {3}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
The Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Battle Hymn and Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may return any other instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard in place of Battle Hymn.

1687-4050-4124-4772.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

15-643-1339-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
15-643-1339-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3096-3367.notablePrerequisites: You have less than three cards in your graveyard.
3096-3367.description:
Cast Paradigm Shift by paying {1}{U}, exiling your library and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to mill two cards and win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
